name: Real-time Digital Twin for Unitree Go1

place.description: 5TONIC Open Research and Innovation Laboratory / Smart Factory

serviceLevelSpecParameters.name: Latency
serviceLevelSpecParameters.transformationAlgorithmOfKQI: Measure average end-to-end round-trip delay between robot and digital twin over a 5-minute interval

serviceLevelSpecParameters.name: Throughput
serviceLevelSpecParameters.transformationAlgorithmOfKQI: Measure sustained bidirectional throughput between robot edge node and control server

serviceLevelSpecParameters.name: Availability
serviceLevelSpecParameters.transformationAlgorithmOfKQI: Measure session uptime percentage within observation period

serviceLevelSpecParameters.name: PacketLoss
serviceLevelSpecParameters.transformationAlgorithmOfKQI: Measure average packet loss ratio over total transmitted packets in 5-minute window

description: This Digital Twin (DT) slice enables real-time control and monitoring for the Unitree Go1 robot. It provides ultra-reliable, low-latency connectivity within the 5TONIC Smart Factory for remote technicians and operators.
